title: Film Projector Surreal Mural
description: A woman in a blue jumpsuit stands in a paint-splattered studio, holding a lit match that ignites a film strip extending from an old movie projector on a wooden stand. The strip transforms into vibrant blue and green swirling vines that drip paint onto a large circular mural containing a rabbit, a waving green teddy bear in a porthole, goldfish, and stylized plants.
prompt: A woman in a blue jumpsuit stands in an art studio holding a burning match, igniting a film strip that emerges from a vintage movie projector on a wooden pedestal. The film strip morphs into swirling blue and green vines dripping paint down a white wall. A large circular painted portal contains a brown rabbit, a green teddy bear waving from an orange porthole, swimming goldfish, stylized plants and flowers, with paint splatters and film reels scattered across the wooden floor.
